symbol_definition: *p<0.05, **p<0.01 in t-test (text on image, top right)
#p<0.05, ##p<0.01 in ANOVA+Tukey's HSD test (text on image, top right)
outputs.explanation: The bar graphs in panel A use asterisk (*) and hash (#) symbols to denote statistical significance. Both symbols are explicitly defined in text printed directly on the figure image ('*p<0.05, **p<0.01 in t-test' and '#p<0.05, ##p<0.01 in ANOVA+Tukey's HSD test'), and the caption further clarifies which tests were used (Student's t-test and one-way ANOVA with Tukey's HSD post hoc test). This is sufficient to interpret the significance markers.
Panel B is an immunoelectron microscopy image, not a plot, and contains no statistical significance symbols.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot, and contains no statistical significance symbols.
Panel D is a western blot image, not a plot, and contains no statistical significance symbols.
